catalogue.title: Affiliation command surface (integrated catalogue entry)
catalogue.trust_boundary: The boundary between a requesting party and the House command handler; requests are untrusted until authenticated and authorized in context.

catalogue.title: Affiliation query surface (integrated catalogue entry)
catalogue.consumer: The Button and other authorized read consumers
catalogue.trust_boundary: The boundary between a read consumer and the House query handler; reads are scoped to the consumer's authorization context and disclosure basis.

catalogue.title: Affiliation domain-event surface (integrated catalogue entry)
catalogue.trust_boundary: The boundary between the House event producer and internal consumers; consumers subscribe under a tenant-scoped grant.

catalogue.title: Provider webhook and callback surface (integrated catalogue entry)
catalogue.trust_boundary: The inbound provider trust boundary; a signal is refused before any governed effect unless authenticated and integrity-verified.

catalogue.title: Notification and delivery surface (integrated catalogue entry)
catalogue.trust_boundary: The outbound boundary between the House notification service and recipients; disclosure is bounded by audience and disclosure authority.

catalogue.title: File and batch exchange surface (integrated catalogue entry)
catalogue.producer: External providers and House export processes
catalogue.trust_boundary: The exchange boundary between an external file or batch source and the House domain; records are non-authoritative until accepted and reconciled.

catalogue.title: Batch exchange surface (integrated catalogue entry)
catalogue.consumer: House batch import and reconciliation processes
catalogue.trust_boundary: The exchange boundary for recurring batch transfers; each batch is scoped, integrity-verified, and reconciled before its records are trusted.

catalogue.title: Migration exchange surface (integrated catalogue entry)
catalogue.consumer: House migration import and reconciliation processes
catalogue.trust_boundary: The migration boundary between a source system and the House domain; unresolved identities are quarantined, never assumed authoritative.
